pour_balls_into_vase: The vase is fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time, all seven balls are inside the vase, the cup is upright (opening up, its axis within 15 degrees of vertical), whether held or put down, and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
deposit_coin: The holder and the coin bank are fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time, the whole coin is inside the coin bank and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 20 if at some moment the coin was lifted more than 8 cm above its starting height, and 0 if not.
fasten_screws: The three screws are fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time, each nut is on the screw of its color: the nut lies flat with the same face up as at the start, its centre is within 1 mm of the screw's centre horizontally, and its bottom is more than 9 mm below the top of the screw; both grippers are fully open; and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 50 if at some moment both grippers are fully open while at least two nuts are on their screws as above, else 20 if this holds at some moment for at least one nut, else 0.
play_Xylophone: The xylophone is fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when the eight keys have been struck in order from left to right. A key counts as struck at the first moment the centre of the mallet head is over the middle part of that key (away from its ends) and just above its top surface. Before the next key can count, the mallet must be lifted more than 2.5 cm above where it was at that moment. The arms need not return to their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
insert_key: The keyhole is fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time, the key is inserted into the keyhole more than 2.5 cm deep, its centre is within 7 mm of the keyhole's centre horizontally, it stands upright within 7 degrees, and it is turned to one particular orientation relative to the keyhole (a key turned the other way does not count). The arms need not return to their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 15 if at some moment the key was lifted more than 5 cm above its starting height, and 0 if not.
insert_tubes: The rack is fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time, each of the three tubes stands upright in the rack, tip down (cap end up), with its tip more than 4.5 cm below the rack's top surface, and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 40 if at some moment both grippers are fully open while at least two tubes stand in the rack as above, else 20 if this holds at some moment for at least one tube, else 0.
build_tower: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: every piece has the same face up as at the start, tilted by less than 5 degrees (turning a piece about the vertical is fine); the long board rests on two small blocks, one of the two that start on the left side of the table and one of the two that start on the right side; the other two small blocks stand on the long board; the shorter board rests on those two blocks, centred above the long board; the small plank lies on the shorter board, its centre within 2.3 cm horizontally of the shorter board's centre and turned to a fixed orientation relative to the shorter board (within 20 degrees); the triangular roof sits ridge up on the small plank, its centre within 2.3 cm horizontally of the plank's centre and turned to a fixed orientation relative to the plank (within 20 degrees); and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 30 if, after the 10 level below has been reached, at some moment both grippers are fully open, the long board, the four small blocks and the shorter board are placed as above, all six with the same face up as at the start, and the shorter board is not moving, else 10 if at some moment both grippers are fully open, the long board rests on two small blocks as above, these three pieces have the same face up as at the start, and the long board is not moving, else 0.
make_toast: The bread rack is fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: each of the toaster's two slots holds a slice of bread seated down in it (not resting on the rim or held above it); exactly two slices are in the bread rack; all four slices stand upright on an edge (any edge), none lying flat; the toaster lever is pressed all the way down; and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 50 if at some moment both grippers are fully open, all four slices stand upright on an edge, and both slots hold a seated slice, else 25 if this holds at some moment with at least one slot holding a seated slice, else 0.
pour_by_language: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when each of the three bottles has passed its check. A bottle is checked each time it is stood back up (its axis coming back to within 30 degrees of vertical after being tilted further; it may still be held), and it passes if its bowl holds its liquid at that moment. Each bottle's bowl is the one the instruction pairs it with. A bowl holds its liquid at a moment when at most 10 percent of its bottle's liquid is still inside the bottle and at least 95 percent of the liquid that has left that bottle is inside the bowl; small scattered droplets outside both are not counted, but if they add up to more than 20 percent of all of that bottle's liquid, the bowl does not hold its liquid. This depends only on where the liquid is at that moment, not on whether the bottle has passed its check. A passed bottle stays passed; after a failed check, that bottle is checked again the next time it is tilted further and stood back up. Success itself does not depend on the order in which the bottles pass (the failure rule below does depend on the instruction's order), and the arms need not return to their initial poses. A return moment is a moment at which the arms go from both being away from their initial poses to at least one of them being back near its initial pose (within 15 cm along each axis and 20 degrees in orientation); while one arm stays near its initial pose, no return moment occurs. The episode fails at once if, at a return moment, a later bowl in the instruction's order (first, second, third) holds its liquid while an earlier bowl does not; partial credit reached before that is kept. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 20 if one of the following states has been found at a return moment, 50 if two or more of them have, and 0 if none has: only the first bowl holds its liquid; only the first and second bowls hold theirs; all three bowls hold theirs.
plug_in_charger: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time, the charger is plugged into the power strip with its prongs pointing straight down and its lowest point more than 1.5 cm below the top surface of the power strip, and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
put_bottles_into_dustbin: The dustbin is fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: each of the four bottles is down in the dustbin, entirely inside it with no part above the dustbin's top; and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit for the highest level reached, where levels are reached in order and a level counts only at a moment when both grippers are fully open and at least that many bottles are in the dustbin as above: 1 bottle 10, 2 bottles 25, 3 bottles 40.
make_kong: This is a game of mahjong: draw, hold and set your tiles as a mahjong player would, following the usual mahjong conventions, in addition to what the scoring rule below checks. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when two stages are completed in order, all conditions of a stage holding at the same moment. Stage 1: the three tiles in your hand that match the tile the opponent discards lie toppled flat, the same side up as the discarded tile; the other tiles of your hand still stand upright on end, tilted less than 7 degrees; and the replacement tile still lies flat, not yet picked up or turned. Stage 2, at a later moment: your hand tiles still meet the stage 1 conditions; the replacement tile stands upright on end as the next tile at the end of your hand row as the row was laid out at the start, in line with the row and spaced like the other tiles, its centre within 1.5 cm of that position, the same way up as your standing hand tiles (upside down does not count) and tilted less than 7 degrees; and both grippers are fully open. The arms need not return to their initial poses. How the opponent plays: its only move is to discard one of its tiles by knocking it over with its arm; this move starts with the episode, and its arm moves only while your own commands advance the simulation. The episode fails at once if, at any moment, the opponent's arm is away from its initial pose (more than 30 cm along any axis or turned more than 40 degrees) while either of your arms is away from its initial pose (more than 30 cm along any axis or turned more than 30 degrees). A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
fill_pen_holder: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: each of the four pens (the markers count as pens) stands in the pen holder, inserted down into it rather than lying across its opening, with one particular end down (the scorer uses a fixed end of each pen; the other end down does not count) and that end near the holder's centre seen from above; the pen holder stands upright; and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit for the highest level reached, where levels are reached in order and a level counts only at a moment when both grippers are fully open, the pen holder stands upright, and at least that many pens stand in it as above: 1 pen 10, 2 pens 25, 3 pens 40, all 4 pens 90.
fill_egg_holder: The basket is fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: each of the four eggs sits down in the egg holder (not resting on its rim or held above it); the egg holder's lid is closed; and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit for the highest level reached, where levels are reached in order and a level counts only at a moment when both grippers are fully open and at least that many eggs sit in the egg holder as above: 1 egg 10, 2 eggs 25, 3 eggs 40, all 4 eggs 90.
play_stacking_toy: The stacking base is fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: the stacking pieces form four groups of identical pieces, and each group has its own designated peg among the four pegs of the stacking base. An episode counts as a success when, at the same time: every group is complete on its designated peg, each of its pieces threaded onto the peg and resting all the way down, with all their centres within 1 mm of the peg's centre and of one another horizontally; and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit for the highest level reached, where levels are reached in order and a level counts only at a moment when both grippers are fully open and at least that many groups are complete on their designated pegs as above: 1 group 10, 2 groups 30, 3 groups 60.
organize_table: The drawer, the stand, the mouse pad, the frame and the monitor are fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time, all four arrangements below hold, none of their objects is moving, and both arms are back in their initial poses. Alarm clock: standing upright anywhere on top of the drawer. Figurine: standing upright on the stand, its centre within 2 cm of the stand's centre horizontally (up to 4.5 cm for some figurines). Mouse: resting on the mouse pad, turned to a fixed required heading within 45 degrees (the reverse heading does not count). Keyboard: lying flat, turned to a fixed required heading within 45 degrees (the reverse heading does not count), and covering, seen from above, the whole of a 20 cm by 6 cm region centred on the centre of the frame (20 cm from left to right), so it must sit centred in the frame. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit for the highest level reached, where levels are reached in order and a level counts only at a moment when both grippers are fully open and at least that many of the four arrangements (any of them) hold as above: 1 arrangement 25, 2 arrangements 50, 3 arrangements 75.
classify_objects: The three baskets are fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: the objects belong to three categories. An episode counts as a success when, at the same time: each basket holds all objects of one category, a different category in each basket (any category may go in any basket); every object is down inside its basket (not resting on its rim or held above it); and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit for the highest level reached, where levels are reached in order and a level counts only at a moment when both grippers are fully open and at least that many baskets are complete and pure (all objects of one category down inside it as above, and no object of another category with its centre over it, seen from above): 1 basket 15, 2 baskets 40.
play_tic_tac_toe: The board is fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time, all nine pieces, your five and the opponent's four, rest on the board, each on one of the nine cells with its centre within 1.5 cm of the cell's centre. Three in a row is not checked, and neither open grippers nor a return of the arms is required for success. How the opponent plays: whenever the cells hold exactly one more of your pieces than of the opponent's (for this count a resting piece may be up to 1.8 cm off a cell's centre) and both your arms are near their initial poses (each within 30 cm of its initial position along every axis and within 30 degrees of its initial orientation), the opponent starts placing its next piece on a randomly chosen free cell; its arm moves only while your own commands advance the simulation. The episode fails at once if, at any moment, either of your arms is not near its initial pose in that sense while the opponent's arm is more than 30 cm from its initial position along any axis or turned more than 40 degrees; partial credit reached before that is kept. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit for the highest level reached, where levels are reached in order and a level counts only at a moment when both grippers are fully open and at least that many of your own pieces rest on cells as for success: 1 piece 10, 2 pieces 30, 3 pieces 50, 4 pieces 75.
push_T: The gray T-shaped pad is fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: the T-shaped block is aligned with the gray T-shaped pad, its centre within 7 mm of the pad's centre horizontally and its orientation within 7 degrees of the pad's; and both arms are back in their initial poses. The episode fails at once if the T-shaped block's centre is ever more than 1 cm higher than at the start. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
push_T_random: The gray T-shaped pad is fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: the T-shaped block is aligned with the gray T-shaped pad, its centre within 7 mm of the pad's centre horizontally and its orientation within 7 degrees of the pad's; and both arms are back in their initial poses. The episode fails at once if the T-shaped block's centre is ever more than 1 cm higher than at the start. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
stack_blocks: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: the three blocks form one stack, each block resting on the one below it with its centre within 1.5 cm of that block's centre horizontally (the blocks' orientation is not checked); and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 15 if at some moment both grippers were fully open while one block rested on another as above, and 0 if not.
stack_blocks_random: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: the three blocks form one stack, each block resting on the one below it with its centre within 1.5 cm of that block's centre horizontally (the blocks' orientation is not checked); and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 15 if at some moment both grippers were fully open while one block rested on another as above, and 0 if not.
stack_bowls: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: the three bowls are stacked one inside another, all upright, with the bottom bowl standing flat (not tilted); and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 15 if at some moment both grippers were fully open while one bowl was stacked inside another, the lower one standing flat and the upper one upright, and 0 if not.
stack_bowls_random: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: the three bowls are stacked one inside another, all upright, with the bottom bowl standing flat (not tilted); and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 15 if at some moment both grippers were fully open while one bowl was stacked inside another, the lower one standing flat and the upper one upright, and 0 if not.
sweep_blocks: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: the centre of every block lies within the dustpan's collecting area, seen from above; the dustpan lies flat on the table (not tilted or raised), its centre more than 10 cm farther left (world -x) than the broom's centre; and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
sweep_blocks_random: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: the centre of every object other than the broom and the dustpan lies within the dustpan's collecting area, seen from above; the dustpan lies flat on the table (not tilted or raised), its centre more than 10 cm farther left (world -x) than the broom's centre; and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
pack_objects_into_box: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: the box stands upright and is turned so that a fixed reference direction of the box lies within 40 degrees of the left-right (world x) axis, either way round; each of the four objects (the car, the electric toothbrush, the hammer and the shoe) has its centre over the box's floor, seen from above, its front facing left (world -x), and its front-to-back direction within 45 degrees of parallel to the box's reference direction, seen from above; and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit for the highest level reached, where levels are reached in order and a level counts only at a moment when both grippers are fully open, the box is upright and turned as above, and at least that many objects meet the object conditions above: 1 object 10, 2 objects 25, 3 objects 50.
pack_objects_into_box_random: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: the box stands upright and is turned so that a fixed reference direction of the box lies within 40 degrees of the left-right (world x) axis, either way round; each of the four objects (the car, the electric toothbrush, the hammer and the shoe) has its centre over the box's floor, seen from above, its front facing left (world -x), and its front-to-back direction within 45 degrees of parallel to the box's reference direction, seen from above; and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit for the highest level reached, where levels are reached in order and a level counts only at a moment when both grippers are fully open, the box is upright and turned as above, and at least that many objects meet the object conditions above: 1 object 10, 2 objects 25, 3 objects 50.
fold_clothes: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when the garment is folded at a moment when both arms come back near their initial poses (within 15 cm along each axis and 20 degrees in orientation) with both grippers fully open. Folded means, seen from above: each sleeve is folded across, its end lying roughly over the opposite side of the chest; and the hem is folded up, each of its two corners lying roughly at the shoulder on its own side. The garment is checked only when that state of the arms and grippers begins, not while it lasts; if the garment is not folded then, it is checked again the next time the state begins. The episode fails at once if, at a moment when either arm comes back near its initial pose, the hem is folded up as above while a sleeve is not folded as above. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 20 if both sleeves were folded as above at a moment when both grippers became fully open (wherever the arms were), and 0 if not; this credit is kept if the episode later fails.
fold_clothes_random: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when the garment is folded at a moment when both arms come back near their initial poses (within 15 cm along each axis and 20 degrees in orientation) with both grippers fully open. Folded means, seen from above: each sleeve is folded across, its end lying roughly over the opposite side of the chest; and the hem is folded up, each of its two corners lying roughly at the shoulder on its own side. The garment is checked only when that state of the arms and grippers begins, not while it lasts; if the garment is not folded then, it is checked again the next time the state begins. The episode fails at once if, at a moment when either arm comes back near its initial pose, the hem is folded up as above while a sleeve is not folded as above. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 20 if both sleeves were folded as above at a moment when both grippers became fully open (wherever the arms were), and 0 if not; this credit is kept if the episode later fails.
hang_mugs: The mug rack is fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: each of the three mugs hangs by its handle on one of the rack's hanging points, with the handle within 4.5 cm of that hanging point, the mug more than 4.5 cm higher than at the start and its handle more than 13.5 cm above the table surface; each mug's handle is oriented like one particular hanging point of the rack, the same reference for every mug whichever hanging point it hangs on (the angular tolerance is wide, and the mug may face either way); and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit for the highest level reached, where levels are reached in order and a level counts only at a moment when both grippers are fully open and at least that many mugs hang on the rack as above and are not moving: 1 mug 15, 2 mugs 40.
hang_mugs_random: The mug rack is fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: each of the three mugs hangs by its handle on one of the rack's hanging points, with the handle within 4.5 cm of that hanging point, the mug more than 4.5 cm higher than at the start and its handle more than 13.5 cm above the table surface; each mug's handle is oriented like one particular hanging point of the rack, the same reference for every mug whichever hanging point it hangs on (the angular tolerance is wide, and the mug may face either way); and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit for the highest level reached, where levels are reached in order and a level counts only at a moment when both grippers are fully open and at least that many mugs hang on the rack as above and are not moving: 1 mug 15, 2 mugs 40.
pour_liquid_into_cup: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at a moment when the bottle is stood back up (its axis coming back to within 30 degrees of vertical after being tilted further), at most 15 percent of the liquid is still in the bottle and at least 97 percent of the liquid that has left the bottle is in the cup. The liquid is checked only at such moments; if the check fails, it is made again the next time the bottle is tilted further and stood back up. The bottle may still be held, and the arms need not return to their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
pour_liquid_into_cup_random: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at a moment when the bottle is stood back up (its axis coming back to within 30 degrees of vertical after being tilted further), at most 15 percent of the liquid is still in the bottle and at least 97 percent of the liquid that has left the bottle is in the cup. The liquid is checked only at such moments; if the check fails, it is made again the next time the bottle is tilted further and stood back up. The bottle may still be held, and the arms need not return to their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
arrange_largest_number: The pads are fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: each digit's centre is within 2 cm of the centre of its own pad, seen from above, where there is one pad per digit in a row and the digits go in descending order from left to right as seen from the robot (the largest digit on the leftmost pad); each digit lies face up and reads correctly from the robot's side, turned less than 45 degrees from that; and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit for the highest level reached, where levels are reached in order and a level counts only at a moment when both grippers are fully open and at least that many digits meet the digit conditions above. With four digits: 1 digit 5, 2 digits 15, 3 digits 30. With five digits: 1 digit 5, 2 digits 15, 3 digits 25, 4 digits 40.
arrange_largest_number_random: The pads are fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: each digit's centre is within 2 cm of the centre of its own pad, seen from above, where there is one pad per digit in a row and the digits go in descending order from left to right as seen from the robot (the largest digit on the leftmost pad); each digit lies face up and reads correctly from the robot's side, turned less than 45 degrees from that; and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit for the highest level reached, where levels are reached in order and a level counts only at a moment when both grippers are fully open and at least that many digits meet the digit conditions above. With four digits: 1 digit 5, 2 digits 15, 3 digits 30. With five digits: 1 digit 5, 2 digits 15, 3 digits 25, 4 digits 40.
sort_nesting_dolls_by_size: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: the five dolls stand upright in a row from left to right as seen from the robot (along world +x), from the smallest at the left to the largest at the right, each doll's centre more than 3 cm farther right (+x) than the centre of the next smaller doll; all five centres are within 3.5 cm of one another front to back (in world y), so that the row runs straight left to right; and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
sort_nesting_dolls_by_size_random: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: the five dolls stand upright in a row from left to right as seen from the robot (along world +x), from the smallest at the left to the largest at the right, each doll's centre more than 3 cm farther right (+x) than the centre of the next smaller doll; all five centres are within 3.5 cm of one another front to back (in world y), so that the row runs straight left to right; and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
store_laptop_and_headphones: The headphone stand, the vertical laptop stand and the stand the laptop starts on are fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: the headphones hang on the headphone stand with the top middle of their headband within 5 cm of the stand's support point, and hanging in one particular orientation relative to the stand, within 30 degrees (a twisted or tilted hang does not count); the laptop is closed; the laptop stands upright on one particular edge, within 10 degrees of vertical, with that edge down inside the vertical laptop stand (standing it on another edge does not count); and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit from two separate items, each counted from the first moment it holds while both grippers are fully open, and kept after that: the headphones hanging as above, 20; the laptop closed, upright and in the vertical laptop stand as above, 80. If both items have been counted, only the one counted first is scored (the headphones if both were counted at the same moment).
store_laptop_and_headphones_random: The headphone stand, the vertical laptop stand and the stand the laptop starts on are fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: the headphones hang on the headphone stand with the top middle of their headband within 5 cm of the stand's support point, and hanging in one particular orientation relative to the stand, within 30 degrees (a twisted or tilted hang does not count); the laptop is closed; the laptop stands upright on one particular edge, within 10 degrees of vertical, with that edge down inside the vertical laptop stand (standing it on another edge does not count); and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit from two separate items, each counted from the first moment it holds while both grippers are fully open, and kept after that: the headphones hanging as above, 20; the laptop closed, upright and in the vertical laptop stand as above, 80. If both items have been counted, only the one counted first is scored (the headphones if both were counted at the same moment).
make_toast_random: The bread rack is fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: each of the toaster's two slots holds a slice of bread seated down in it (not resting on the rim or held above it); exactly two slices are in the bread rack; all four slices stand upright on an edge (any edge), none lying flat; the toaster lever is pressed all the way down; and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 50 if at some moment both grippers are fully open, all four slices stand upright on an edge, and both slots hold a seated slice, else 25 if this holds at some moment with at least one slot holding a seated slice, else 0.
align_blocks: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: the three blocks form a straight row seen from above, every block's centre within 8 mm of the straight line that best fits the three centres (the row may run in any direction, at any spacing); each block has one of its edges parallel to that line within 8 degrees; and both arms are back in their initial poses. The episode fails at once if, at any moment, any block's centre is more than 7 mm higher than at the start. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
general_pickup: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when the object the instruction names is lifted so that its centre is more than 10 cm above where it started. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
solve_equation: The pads are fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: a token that starts off the pads is correct if, placed on the empty pad, it makes the equation shown at the start true; when several would, any of them counts. An episode counts as a success when, at the same time: a correct token lies on the empty pad, its centre within 1.8 cm of the pad's centre seen from above, face up and reading upright from the robot's side, with no exception for tokens that look the same rotated or flipped; and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
stack_blocks_by_language: Scoring rule: the instruction names the three block colours from bottom to top; call the blocks of these colours the bottom, middle and top block. An episode counts as a success when, at the same time: the middle block rests on the bottom block and the top block rests on the middle block, each with its centre within 1.75 cm horizontally of the centre of the block below it (the blocks' orientation is not checked); and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 20 if at some moment both grippers were fully open while the middle block rested directly on the bottom block, centred on it as above, and the bottom block was on the table, and 0 if not.
classify_objects_by_language: The three baskets are fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an object is in a basket when its centre is within the basket's outline seen from above. An episode counts as a success when, at the same time: every object is in the basket the instruction assigns to its category and lies down inside it (not resting on its rim or held above it); and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit for the highest level reached, where levels are reached in order and a level counts only at a moment when both grippers are fully open and at least that many baskets are complete and pure (all objects of the basket's assigned category lie down inside it as above, and no object of another category is in it): 1 basket 10, 2 baskets 40.
pick_from_conveyor_by_image: The board with the image is fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: the target object (the one shown in the image on the board) lies on the basket's bottom, its lowest point no more than 4 cm above the basket's lowest point, and is entirely inside the basket: seen from above, its whole outline is within the basket's outline, and its top is lower than the basket's top; and the target object's centre is more than 8 cm higher than where it started on the conveyor. How the conveyor works: like everything in the simulation, it moves only while your own commands advance the simulation. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
store_tools_in_toolbox: The toolbox is fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: each of the four tools lies in its own matching slot in the toolbox, within a few centimetres of where that slot holds it and turned to the orientation the slot is made for within 10 degrees (tilt included; for the pliers, lying turned over, the other face up, also counts); each tool is entirely inside the toolbox: seen from above, its whole outline is within the toolbox's outline, and its top is lower than the toolbox's top; and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit for the highest level reached, where levels are reached in order and a level counts only at a moment when both grippers are fully open and at least that many tools are each in their own slot and entirely inside the toolbox as above, whatever their orientation: 1 tool 25, 2 tools 50, 3 tools 75.
cover_blocks: Scoring rule: left, middle and right mean the blocks' order at the start as seen from the robot (toward world -x, the left arm's side). A block is covered when any of the three cups is down over it: seen from above, the block lies entirely within the cup's outline, and the cup's rim is less than 3 cm above the bottom of the block. A block is uncovered when no cup covers it. An episode counts as a success when six stages are completed in order, each at a later moment than the previous one, all conditions of a stage holding at the same moment, and with all three cups upside down (opening facing down, within 10 degrees of vertical) at every stage. Stage 1: the left block is covered, the middle and right blocks are uncovered. Stage 2: the left and middle blocks are covered, the right block is uncovered. Stage 3: all three blocks are covered. Stage 4: the red block is uncovered, the green and blue blocks are covered. Stage 5: the red and green blocks are uncovered, the blue block is covered. Stage 6: all three blocks are uncovered, and both arms are back in their initial poses. The episode fails at once if, at any moment, any block is more than 5 cm from where it started (lifting included); partial credit reached before that is kept. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit for the highest stage reached in this sequence: stage 3 5, stage 4 15, stage 5 30 (stages 1 and 2 give nothing).
match_and_pick_from_conveyor: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when the object matching the first object on the conveyor, an identical copy of it that comes later, is lifted so that its centre is more than 10 cm above where it started on the conveyor. Lifting the first object itself does not count. How the conveyor works: like everything in the simulation, it moves only while your own commands advance the simulation. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
swap_blocks: The three mats are fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: a block is on a mat when it is down on the mat, centred on it (only a small offset is tolerated). The swap takes exactly three moves, each carrying one block onto the mat that is empty at that time, and ends with each block on the mat where the other block started. An episode counts as a success when, for each move in turn, these moments occur in order, each later than the one before: (1) the moving block is lifted more than 3 cm above its height at the end of the previous move (for the first move, its starting height) while the other block is on its current mat (where it started or was last placed); (2) the moving block is on its new mat and the other block still on its current mat; (3) the button is pressed down more than halfway; (4) the button is back (almost) fully up, for the third move at a moment when both arms are also back in their initial poses. Every time the button goes down more than halfway from (almost) fully up counts as a press, including presses outside this sequence; the episode fails at once on the fourth press. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
swap_T: Scoring rule: an episode counts as a success when, at the same time: each T-shaped block has taken the other block's starting place, its centre within 2 cm horizontally of where the other block's centre was at the start and its orientation within 3 degrees of the other block's starting orientation (tilt included); and both arms are back in their initial poses. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
press_by_number: The two number cards are fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: a press is a button going down more than halfway from (almost) fully up and coming back (almost) fully up. An episode counts as a success when the presses happen in this order: the left one of the two red buttons (as seen from the robot) as many times as the number on its card, the blue button once, the other red button as many times as the number on its card, the blue button once more; and then both arms are back in their initial poses while the blue button is up. A press out of this order does not advance the sequence but still counts toward its button's total (the card's number for a red button, two for the blue button); the episode fails at once when a button goes down for a press beyond its total. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode scores 0 (there is no partial credit).
imitate_sorting_sequence: The two baskets are fixed in place and cannot be moved by the robot. Scoring rule: a third arm, the demonstrator, puts its five objects one at a time into one of the baskets. The other basket is yours, and so are the other five objects, one of the same kind for each of the demonstrator's; their order is the order in which the demonstrator placed the matching objects. An object is in a basket when its centre is within the basket's outline seen from above, at any height above the basket's bottom. An episode counts as a success when, with all five of the demonstrator's objects in its basket each time, these moments occur in order, each later than the one before: exactly the first of your objects is in your basket; exactly the first two are; and so on, until all five are in it while both arms are back in their initial poses. How the demonstration works: the demonstrator's arm replays a recorded motion that starts with the episode; like everything in the simulation, it moves only while your own commands advance the simulation. The episode fails at once if, at any moment, the demonstrator's arm is away from its initial pose (more than 30 cm along any axis or turned more than 40 degrees) while either of your arms is away from its initial pose (more than 30 cm along any axis or turned more than 30 degrees); or if, at a moment when both grippers are open, one of your objects lies still in your basket while an object before it in the order is not in it; partial credit reached before a failure is kept. A success scores 100; otherwise the episode gets partial credit for the highest level reached, where levels are reached in order and a level counts only at a moment when both grippers are fully open, all five of the demonstrator's objects are in its basket, and exactly the first that many of your objects are in your basket: 1 object 5, 2 objects 15, 3 objects 30, 4 objects 50.
